cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a financial ombudsman or a Bank of Algeria complaints unit takes complaints about digital financial services.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-12: Bank of Algeria Instruction 06-2025 of August 2025 sets escrow, guarantee and contract-disclosure rules for payment service providers, which answers question 2 after the 2024 drafting. No complaints body is on record.
